title: Down the Rabbit Hole: Detecting Online Extremism, Radicalisation, and Politicised Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review focused on the technical and socio-technical processes for detecting online extremism and hate speech. While it includes discussions on researcher ethics, data privacy (GDPR), and notes biases regarding the targeting of religious groups (specifically Islamic extremism), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, theology, or moral frameworks as a central component of its research.
